dossier.scp_unleashed.031.title: What Is Love
dossier.scp_unleashed.031.caption: SCP-031 at long range, beside a dwelling in its settlement.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-031 instances are to be held in separate cells and watched by camera from at least 70 metres away. No one is to enter a cell in person.
**Anyone who sees a familiar face in a cell is to leave the room at once.**
Cells are to be searched for polyps after every incident. Polyps are soft and are to be crushed on sight.
An instance loose in a settlement is found by counting heads. There will be one person too many.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-031 is an upright mass of red muscle about two metres tall. It has no limbs. Its body narrows toward the top into a rounded swelling that some staff describe as a head.

That is how it looks from more than about 64 metres away. Any closer, every observer sees a person instead: most often someone they know, and never themselves. Two observers standing together may each see someone different, and each is certain.

It approaches at a walk, crouching and standing again and again in a friendly greeting, and stepping aside now and then as a person would. Close enough, it embraces its subject. The subject cannot pull away, and does not survive a long embrace. Villagers are taken the same way.
A small polyp remains where a subject was lost. Over several minutes it swells and rises as a new instance. %rRemainder of the growth record withheld.%r
A hard enough blow breaks its grip. Its tissue is tough, but it can be put down.

page.title: Addendum 031-1: Interview Log
text: Agent %rKessler%r reported that the instance in Cell 4 was his sister, waving at him through the glass. The agent beside him saw a stranger in a green shirt. Both described it crouching, over and over, as if to say hello.
Neither was permitted to enter the cell.

page.title: Addendum 031-2: Recovery
page.text: SCP-031 was first recorded in a remote settlement, where two or three instances lived openly among the villagers. The residents noticed nothing unusual. Its location is given in the field notes.

jade.scp_unleashed.scp031_polyp.hint: Soft. A blow or two will crush it.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp031.spawned: Spawned SCP-031 at %s, %s, %s (%s of %s in this dimension)
commands.scp_unleashed.scp031.polyp: Sprouted an SCP-031 polyp at %s, %s, %s (stage %s of %s)
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp031.1: SCP-031 is a lump of red tissue. From more than %s blocks away it looks like what it is. Any closer, each viewer sees another player from their own tab list, never themselves, or a plain stranger if nobody else is online. Two viewers may see two different people.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp031.2: It notices players in survival or adventure, villagers and person-like NPCs within %s blocks and walks toward them, unhurried. Within %s blocks it crouches over and over in a friendly greeting, side-steps like a person and keeps coming.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp031.3: Within %s blocks it embraces its target. The target cannot walk, jump or strike it, cannot heal, and dies in about 7 seconds from full health.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp031.4: Dealing %s damage to it during an embrace breaks its grip, and it waits 5 seconds before trying again. The one being held cannot strike it. It takes half damage from most sources and does not burn in daylight. An ender pearl also breaks free.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp031.5: Every person it kills leaves a polyp where they fell. It drops nothing of value.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp031_polyp.1: A small nub of flesh, left where SCP-031 killed someone. It is soft: a blow or two crushes it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp031_polyp.2: Over %s to %s minutes it swells through %s visible stages, then stands up as a new SCP-031.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp031_polyp.3: A dimension holds at most %s SCP-031. A polyp that matures past that limit withers away instead.
